evidence.note: IEP places this work in its working chronology of Plato's accepted dialogues and separately identifies the spuria/dubia.
Schofield's Routledge Encyclopedia treatment isolates the principal live authenticity problems rather than this work.

rationale: Republic belongs to the core set of dialogues strongly accepted as Platonic in current reference scholarship and is not a live authorship problem comparable to the project's B/C/D cases. A does not imply settled chronology or that every dramatic speech expresses Plato's own beliefs.
